readerAccess: The first 3 canonical pages are free where a preview is available. A Reading Pass is required beyond the preview on pass-required editions.
listeningAccess: Listening is available only for released audiobooks and requires an active Reading Pass.

homeTitle: Carry a world of stories into your day.
homeIntroduction: Wander through Bengali and English classics. Find fresh language, unexpected company and another way of seeing—on the page, or in an available audiobook.
libraryDescription: A familiar voice, a fresh perspective, another chapter: explore Bengali and English classics in Earnalism's online library.
aboutIntroduction: Bengali and English classics, within the rhythm of everyday life. Read online, discover selected audiobooks, and return when curiosity calls.
aboutBenefit: Words gathered in a spare moment can become a clearer question, a richer conversation or a fresh idea for study and work. Read at your own pace; let curiosity find a practical life beyond the page.
